prompt_text:
Continue the text below with exactly one short, natural, coherent English sentence. Return only the continuation, with no preamble or explanation:
When you die, you appear in a cinema with a number of other people who look like you. You find out that they are your previous reincarnations, and soon you all begin watching your next life on the big screen. We are all lonely spirits waiting for our next life to unfold. 
The movie started with a baby girl born in a rich family. She was named Anna, and she was the youngest of five children. Anna had a happy childhood, but her parents died in a car accident when she was only 14 years old. She was sent to an orphanage, where she met a boy named David. They fell in love and ran away together. They lived in a small cottage in the woods. David was a good man, but he had a dark secret. He could not sleep at night! He was afraid of the dark, and he had to keep the lights on all night long.
reference_text: David was afraid that he would see a monster in the dark. Anna was a good wife, and she tried to help him. She thought of all possible solutions to solve David's problem. You know what she finally came up with? They decided to stay active during the night and make themselves very busy and tired.
